vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component defines the ICubemapSides interface, which serves as a strongly-typed contract for managing cubemap texture paths. It mandates the presence of six specific directional string references: right, left, up, bottom, front, and back. Its primary architectural role is to standardize data access for rendering and asset loading services across the engine. It functions purely as a data structure definition without implementing complex logic or side effects.

graph_nodes.label: Interface
graph_nodes.name: ICubemapSides
graph_nodes.signature: export interface ICubemapSides { right: string, left: string, up: string, bottom: string, front: string, back: string }
